stance_basis: appointed 50-member citizen committee to support favorable federal decision on the Buffalo-Amherst rail rapid transit project
summary: The New York State Transportation Commissioner took an active supportive role in the Buffalo-Amherst rail rapid transit project by appointing a 50-member citizen's committee in July 1975 to mobilize community support and press for a favorable federal decision. This action is described as part of the broader community participation and political support effort surrounding the Metrorail project.
complaint_summary: The New York State Transportation Commissioner appointed a 50-member citizen's committee called the Committee for Federal Action in July 1975 to support local efforts toward a favorable federal decision on the Buffalo-Amherst rail rapid transit project.
summary_quote: In July 1975, the New York State Transportation Commissioner appointed a 50-member citizen's committee to support local efforts directed toward a favorable decision on the Buffalo-Amherst rail rapid transit project.
